activities.title: Introduction
activities.lede: The distributive law does not change when one bracket has three terms: each term in the binomial multiplies every term in the trinomial.

introduction.why: This extends bracket expansion to larger polynomial products without introducing a new method.
introduction.keyIdea: Each term in the binomial must multiply all three terms in the trinomial.
method: Distribute the first term across the trinomial.
Distribute the second term across the trinomial.

activities.title: Video
activities.lede: Watch: expanding products involving a trinomial.
focusPoints: How each binomial term is distributed across all three trinomial terms.
How powers and signs are kept organised.
How like terms are collected at the end.

steps.text: Distribute each binomial term across all three trinomial terms.
Keep the negative sign attached to 3 while distributing.
Distribute both terms across all three trinomial terms.
